formal_role: Identifies which convergence test or bounding argument is used
review_warning: A convergence claim without a named test or bound is weak

formal_role: Documents the assumptions required by the selected test
systems_modeling_role: Prevents tests from being applied outside their valid structure
review_warning: A correct test used under false conditions gives misleading confidence

formal_role: Records the finite computation actually performed
systems_modeling_role: Separates computed finite totals from infinite limiting claims
review_warning: A partial sum is not the same as an infinite series

formal_role: Documents the omitted tail or error bound after truncation
review_warning: A small last term does not always bound the full tail

formal_role: Records when a test fails to classify convergence
systems_modeling_role: Prevents unsupported conclusions after an inconclusive test
review_warning: An inconclusive test should lead to another test or a limited claim
